title: 第5章 登门债 上第6章 登门债 下
slug: 修仙开局一部手机修为全靠买
content_zh:
阴阳山的山门在晨光里显得格外巍峨。
刘叙白站在石阶尽头，手里攥着那枚铜色通行令，指尖冰凉的金属触感让他格外清醒。守门的执戟弟子验过令牌，上下打量了他一眼，目光里带着几分毫不掩饰的诧异——一个炼气期的散修，大清早独自一人持通行令上山，这种事在阴阳门不多见。
“秦长老可在？”刘叙白收回令牌，语气平淡。
“秦长老今日清早就出门访友去了，不在山中。”执戟弟子答道。
不在。刘叙白心里微微一动。昨天才给他定了三日之期，今天就出门访友，时机未免太过巧合。要么秦怀安是故意避开，给他留出考虑的时间；要么就是有人刻意安排好了这个空档——周元纬说的两天，秦怀安未必不知道。
但不管怎样，秦怀安不在，对他来说未必是坏事。
“周元纬周公子可在？”他接着问。
执戟弟子愣了一下，和同伴对视一眼：“周师兄这个时辰应当在东院的演武场练剑。你找周师兄何事？”
“私事。”刘叙白没有多解释，抱拳道了声谢，径直穿过山门，朝东院走去。
阴阳门的东院是外门弟子的居住和修炼区域，占地极广，青石铺就的甬道两旁种满了四季常青的铁松，松枝修剪得整整齐齐，每一棵都笔直如剑。甬道尽头是一片开阔的演武场，方圆数十丈，地面铺着厚重的青石板，石板上布满了深浅不一的剑痕——那是无数弟子日夜苦练留下的印记。
刘叙白走到演武场边缘的时候，场中正有七八个外门弟子在练剑。统一的深蓝劲装，统一的制式长剑，动作整齐划一，剑光在晨光中翻飞如浪。一个穿着锦缎练功服的年轻男人站在队列前方，腰间佩着一柄剑鞘镶玉的长剑，正背着手巡视，时不时停下来纠正某个弟子的剑招。
刘叙白只消一眼就认出了他。
周元纬。黑松林里堵路夺宝的那个年轻男人，秦怀安的师侄，孙主事口中那个“大度不计较”的周公子。他比那天在黑松林里看起来更衣冠楚楚，头发用玉冠束得一丝不苟，面皮白净，五官算得上俊朗，但眉宇间那股子居高临下的倨傲劲儿，隔着老远都能闻到。
刘叙白站在演武场边上，安安静静地等着。他没有出声，没有上前，就那么站着，像一个不起眼的旁观者。直到周元纬巡视完一圈，转过身来，视线扫过演武场边缘的时候，两个人的目光终于撞在了一起。
周元纬愣了一下。
显然他没料到会在这里看到刘叙白。按照他的预想，这个散修此刻应该在青石镇上惶惶不安地数着倒计时，而不是大摇大摆地出现在阴阳门东院的演武场上。但他只愣了一瞬，随即嘴角勾起一个意味不明的笑容，朝身边的弟子摆了摆手，示意他们继续练，然后不紧不慢地朝刘叙白走了过来。
“刘叙白？”他在三步之外停下，居高临下地打量着刘叙白，语气里带着一股漫不经心的轻慢，“秦长老给你三天，我宽限你两天。这才第一天，你就急着上山了？想通了？”
“想通了。”刘叙白说。
周元纬的笑容扩大了几分：“那很好。识时务者为俊杰，你早这么痛快，你那个朋友也不至于——”
“我想通的不是入宗。”刘叙白打断了他的话，声音不大，但每个字都清清楚楚，“我想通的是——陈砚那两拳，不该白挨。”

周元纬的笑容僵在了脸上。
演武场上的剑啸声不知什么时候停了下来。七八个外门弟子停下了手里的剑招，齐刷刷地朝这边看过来。晨风卷过青石板地面，吹起几片枯黄的松针，在两人之间打着旋飘过。周元纬眯起眼睛，那双原本还算好看的眼睛里慢慢沁出一层冷意，像是结了冰的湖水，表面平静，底下翻涌着暗流。
“你说什么？”他的声音降了半度。
“我说，你打了陈砚两拳。一拳在左眼眶，一拳在右眼眶。”刘叙白的声音依旧很稳，像是在陈述一件稀松平常的事实，“他还断了一条胳膊，伤在小臂中段，骨折。你让人按住他，他连还手的机会都没有。所以今天我来，替他讨这笔债。”
周元纬盯着他看了两息，忽然笑了。那不是愤怒的笑，也不是嘲讽的笑，而是一种猎人发现猎物主动送上门的愉悦的笑。
“有趣。”他把腰间的长剑解下来，在手里掂了掂，剑鞘镶着的玉石在日光下闪过一道温润的光泽，“你说讨债，怎么个讨法？”
“散修刘叙白，炼气三层，斗胆挑战阴阳门外门弟子周元纬。宗门规矩，外门弟子不得无故欺凌散修。你无故打了陈砚，按规矩，我有权以挑战讨公道。”刘叙白拔出腰间的精铁长剑，剑尖斜指地面，手很稳，声音更稳，“周公子，你接不接？”
此言一出，整个演武场安静了整整三息。
然后一片哗然。
一个炼气期的散修，登门挑战宗门正式弟子，这种事不是没有过，但每一次的结果都一样——散修被打得半死丢下山去，运气好的断几根骨头，运气不好的废掉修为。更何况，周元纬的修为在同辈外门弟子中不算顶尖，但也有炼气五层的底子，比刘叙白高出整整两个小境界。
“炼气三层挑战炼气五层？这人疯了。”“不是疯了就是活腻了。”弟子们的窃窃私语声此起彼伏，所有人都用一种看死人的眼神看着刘叙白。
周元纬把剑从鞘中拔了出来。剑身如水，灵光潋滟，那是一件真正入了品级的灵器——六品仙器固然谈不上，但至少也是入了宝器上品的货色，比刘叙白手里那柄精铁凡剑强了不止一个档次。他单手举剑，剑尖遥遥指向刘叙白的咽喉，姿态随意得像是在指一件无足轻重的摆设。
“挑战我？”他剑尖微挑，剑锋上的寒光在刘叙白眼前晃了晃，语气里满是居高临下的轻蔑，“炼气三层挑战炼气五层，你也配？刘叙白，我给你两个选择——第一，立刻跪下道歉，然后乖乖入宗，从此以后在外门给我当三年杂役，之前的事一笔勾销。第二，应你的挑战。不过刀剑无眼，我下手从不会太轻。”
刘叙白没有动，只是将剑尖从地面抬起了三寸。
“你打了陈砚两拳。”他重复了一遍，语气平淡得像是在报菜名，“两拳抵一剑。你接我一剑，不管结果如何，这笔债一笔勾销。”
周元纬脸上的笑意更深了，那是一种猎人看到猎物主动往陷阱里跳的愉悦。他几乎没有任何犹豫，将手中的灵剑挽了个剑花，剑身发出一声清越的嗡鸣：“一剑？好，我就接你一剑。不过你记住了——你只出一剑，我不保证你能站着离开演武场。”
“一诺既定。”刘叙白将长剑平举，剑锋与眉齐。

content_en:
The gate of Yin Yang Mountain looks particularly majestic in the morning light.
Liu Xubai stood at the end of the stone steps, holding the copper-colored pass in his hand. The cold metal touch on his fingertips made him particularly awake. The gatekeeper holding the halberd checked the token and looked him up and down with a bit of undisguised surprise in his eyes - a casual cultivator in the Qi refining period went up the mountain alone with a pass early in the morning. This kind of thing is rare in the Yin and Yang Sect.
"Is Elder Qin here?" Liu Xubai took back the token and spoke calmly.
"Elder Qin went out to visit friends early this morning and was not in the mountains." The disciple holding the halberd replied.
Not here. Liu Xubai's heart moved slightly. The three-day period was set for him yesterday, and today he went out to visit friends. The timing was too coincidental. Either Qin Huaian deliberately avoided it to give him time to think about it; or someone had deliberately arranged this gap - Qin Huaian may not have known about the two days Zhou Yuanwei mentioned.
But no matter what, Qin Huaian's absence may not be a bad thing for him.
"Is Mr. Zhou Yuanwei here?" he asked next.
The disciple holding the halberd was stunned for a moment, and looked at his companion: "Senior Brother Zhou should be practicing swordplay in the martial arts field in the east courtyard at this time. What do you want from Senior Brother Zhou?"
"Private matters." Liu Xubai didn't explain much. He cupped his fists and said thank you, then walked straight through the mountain gate and walked towards the east courtyard.
The east courtyard of the Yin Yang Sect is the living and training area for the outer sect disciples. It occupies a very large area. The bluestone-paved corridor is lined with evergreen iron pines. The pine branches are neatly pruned, and each tree is as straight as a sword. At the end of the corridor is an open martial arts field with a radius of several tens of feet. The ground is paved with thick bluestone slabs, and the slabs are covered with sword marks of varying depths - marks left by countless disciples who have practiced hard day and night.
When Liu Xubai walked to the edge of the martial arts arena, there were seven or eight outer disciples practicing swordsmanship. Uniform dark blue attire, uniform long sword, uniform movements, sword light flying like waves in the morning light. A young man wearing brocade practice clothes stood in front of the queue, wearing a long sword with a jade scabbard on his waist. He was patrolling with his hands behind his back, stopping from time to time to correct a disciple's sword moves.
Liu Xubai recognized him at just one glance.
Zhou Yuanwei. The young man who blocked the road in the black pine forest to seize the treasure, Qin Huaian's nephew, the "generous and careless" Mr. Zhou in the words of Master Sun. He looked even more well-dressed than that day in the black pine forest, his hair was neatly tied with a jade crown, his face was fair, and his facial features were handsome, but the condescending and arrogant air between his brows could be smelled from a long distance away.
Liu Xubai stood at the edge of the martial arts arena and waited quietly. He didn't say anything, didn't step forward, just stood there like an inconspicuous bystander. It wasn't until Zhou Yuanwei finished his inspection, turned around, and glanced at the edge of the martial arts arena that the two people's eyes finally met.
Zhou Yuanwei was stunned for a moment.
Obviously he didn't expect to see Liu Xubai here. According to his expectations, this casual cultivator should be anxiously counting the countdown in Qingshi Town at this moment, instead of showing up struttingly on the martial arts field in the east courtyard of Yin Yang Gate. But he was only stunned for a moment, and then a smile with unknown meaning appeared at the corner of his mouth. He waved his hand to the disciples beside him, indicating that they should continue practicing, and then walked towards Liu Xubai unhurriedly.
"Liu Xubai?" He stopped three steps away and looked at Liu Xubai condescendingly, with a careless scorn in his tone. "Elder Qin will give you three days, and I will grant you two days of grace. This is only the first day, and you are in a hurry to go up the mountain? Have you figured it out?"
"I figured it out," Liu Xubai said.
Zhou Yuanwei's smile widened a bit: "That's good. Those who know the current affairs are heroes. If you are so happy, your friend will not--"
"What I have figured out is not to join the clan." Liu Xubai interrupted him, his voice was not loud, but every word was clear, "What I have figured out is that Chen Yan's two punches should not have been in vain."Zhou Yuanwei's smile froze on his face.
The roar of swords in the martial arts arena stopped at some point. Seven or eight outer disciples stopped their sword moves and looked over in unison. The morning breeze blew across the bluestone floor, blowing up a few yellow pine needles and swirling between the two of them. Zhou Yuanwei squinted his eyes, and a layer of coldness gradually appeared in his originally pretty eyes, like frozen lake water, calm on the surface but with an undercurrent surging underneath.
"What did you say?" His voice dropped half a tone.
"I said, you punched Chen Yan twice. One punch was in the left eye socket, and one punch was in the right eye socket." Liu Xubai's voice was still very steady, as if he was stating an ordinary fact, "He also broke an arm, injured in the middle of the forearm, and fractured. You asked people to hold him down, but he didn't even have a chance to fight back. So today I am here to collect this debt for him."
Zhou Yuanwei stared at him for a few breaths, then suddenly smiled. It was not an angry smile, nor a mocking smile, but the happy smile of a hunter who found his prey and took the initiative to bring it to his door.
"Interesting." He took off the long sword from his waist and weighed it in his hand. The jade inlaid in the scabbard flashed a warm luster in the sunlight. "You said you want to collect debts. How do you collect debts?"
"Rogue cultivator Liu Xubai, who is on the third level of Qi Refining, dared to challenge Zhou Yuanwei, an outer disciple of the Yin Yang Sect. According to the sect's rules, outer disciples are not allowed to bully casual cultivators for no reason. You hit Chen Yan for no reason. According to the rules, I have the right to challenge you to seek justice." Liu Xubai pulled out the fine iron long sword at his waist, pointed the tip of the sword diagonally at the ground, his hand was steady, and his voice was even more steady, "Mr. Zhou, will you answer?"
As soon as these words came out, the entire martial arts arena was quiet for three breaths.
Then there was an uproar.
It is not uncommon for a casual cultivator in the Qi refining stage to come to challenge the official disciples of the sect, but the result is the same every time - the casual cultivator is beaten to death and thrown down the mountain. If he is lucky, a few bones will be broken, and if he is unlucky, his cultivation will be ruined. What's more, Zhou Yuanwei's cultivation level is not top-notch among the outer disciples of his generation, but he also has the foundation of the fifth level of Qi refining, which is two whole realms higher than Liu Xubai.
"The third level of Qi Refining challenges the fifth level of Qi Refining? This person is crazy." "Either he is crazy or he is tired of living." The disciples whispered one after another, and everyone looked at Liu Xubai with a look of death.
Zhou Yuanwei pulled the sword out of its sheath. The sword body is like water, and the aura is shining. It is a truly high-grade spiritual weapon - although it cannot be said to be a sixth-grade fairy weapon, it is at least a high-grade treasure weapon. It is more than one grade better than the fine iron sword in Liu Xubai's hand. He raised the sword with one hand, pointing the tip of the sword far away at Liu Xubai's throat, with a casual gesture as if he was pointing at an insignificant ornament.
"Challenge me?" The tip of his sword was slightly raised, and the cold light on the blade flashed in front of Liu Xubai's eyes. His tone was full of condescending contempt, "Are you worthy of challenging the fifth level of Qi Refining at the third level of Qi Refining? Liu Xubai, I give you two choices - first, kneel down and apologize immediately, and then join the sect obediently. From now on, you will serve me as a handyman in the outer sect for three years, and the previous affairs will be wiped out. Second, I will accept your challenge. But the sword has no eyes, and I will never strike too lightly."
Liu Xubai did not move, but raised the tip of the sword three inches from the ground.
"You punched Chen Yan twice." He repeated, his tone as calm as if he was announcing the name of a dish, "Two punches are worth a sword. You take my sword, no matter what the result is, this debt will be written off."
The smile on Zhou Yuanwei's face deepened, it was the joy of a hunter seeing his prey actively jumping into the trap. Without any hesitation, he curled up the spiritual sword in his hand, and the sword made a clear buzzing sound: "One sword? Okay, I'll take your sword. But remember - you only use one sword, and I don't guarantee that you can leave the martial arts arena standing."
"A promise is made." Liu Xubai raised his long sword levelly, with the tip of the sword level with his eyebrows.
